answer: An identity buys its seat with Endorsed sailmaker canvas file at the pier house with sailmakers endorsement; the price of the seat is 4-year yard service, 125 supervised stitchings, master review, annual fees. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 679 aliases, 679 proofs, 66542 POA, 10864 minutes, no shortcuts. The signal proves one person, the island prices one forgery, and the mesa remembers one epoch after another. Honest work is cheap once; dishonest work is expensive forever.
